title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. translated_title: LEGO-OPD：面向多模态在线策略蒸馏的因子化教师组合
translated_abstract: 多模态在线策略蒸馏（OPD）旨在提升视觉定位能力，同时保留语言模型强大的推理能力。近期的多教师方法将LLM与VLM教师相结合以提供互补的监督。然而，直接使用VLM的完整预测分布会将其视觉定位信号与自身的语言先验纠缠在一起，阻碍了定位信息的独立迁移。反过来，增强视觉监督的强度虽然可以改善感知，但可能过度强调视觉证据，从而损害语言推理能力。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了LEGO-OPD，它选择性地将语言专家和定位专家的因子组合成一个教师分布，用于多模态OPD。在广义贝叶斯框架下，语言专家提供候选token上的先验分布，而定位专家贡献一个用于更新的视觉似然……
tldr: 提出LEGO-OPD，在广义贝叶斯框架下将语言专家的token先验与定位专家的视觉似然因子化并选择性组合为单一教师分布，从而解决多模态在线策略蒸馏中视觉感知与语言推理难以兼顾的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: LEGO-OPD factorizes and selectively composes a Language Expert's token prior with a Grounding Expert's visual likelihood into a single teacher distribution under a generalized Bayesian formulation, resolving the trade-off between visual grounding and language reasoning in multimodal on-policy distillation.
